summary: Quicksand harnesses stranded datacenter resources by decomposing applications into fine-grained 'resource proclets' that its runtime places, splits, merges, and migrates according to live resource availability. Figure 2 illustrates this with two machines side by side: Machine 1 has spare RAM but CPU nearing capacity (flagged with a warning icon on its CPU bar), while Machine 2 has spare CPU but RAM nearing capacity. Blue memory proclets are placed on Machine 1 and orange compute proclets on Machine 2, matching each resource type to where it is available; Machine 1 also hosts a gray hybrid proclet that needs both CPU and RAM. Dashed arrows show new proclets being created and placed, a proclet splitting on Machine 1, another merging on Machine 2, and compute proclets migrating from the CPU-constrained Machine 1 to the CPU-rich Machine 2.
